open_points.subject: recovery after a failed placement-record write
open_points.text: State 4 says, “An image left by a failed record write is completed by a repeated delivery of the same file.” A3 rule 5 says it “completes the placement, unless a refusal of A6 rule 5 applies.”
open_points.question: If an A6 rule 5 refusal applies when the delivery is repeated, does the repeat refuse with M08 or complete the placement?
options: Refuse with M08 and leave the orphaned image without a placement record.
Complete the placement despite the A6 rule 5 condition.
open_points.default_guess: Apply A6 rule 5: refuse with M08; complete the placement only when no such refusal applies.

witness.initial: A delivery has stored the image, its placement-record write failed, and the project lock file now cannot be opened.
events: The calling agent repeats delivery of the same file.
module:photo_delivery asks capability:delivery_store.project_lock to acquire the project lock.
module:delivery_store cannot open the lock file.
outcomes: A6 rule 5 gives M08 with state_unavailable and no placement record is written.
State 4's unconditional recovery sentence says the repeated delivery completes the placement.
witness.observer: The calling agent sees refusal instead of completion, and later readers see whether the placement record exists.
